BiblicalUsage: Yâqad is the burning of fire kindled, whether in anger or in glory. Moses warns of a fire kindled in God's anger that burns to the lowest hell, and Isaiah says the LORD will kindle a burning like fire under the glory of the proud.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's fire is no accident, and the same flame that judges the proud purifies His people.
